name: Model request
about: Propose a new model for the model library
title: "[model] "
labels: model
---

Every model needs the five items below before it can be merged.

## Name and use case

<!-- What phenomenon does it describe? Who uses it? -->

## Equation

<!-- Plain text or LaTeX, e.g. y = a * (1 - exp(-b * x)) -->

## Parameter definitions

<!-- Name, meaning, units, sensible bounds and starting-value strategy for each parameter. -->

## References

<!-- Standard, paper or textbook, with section/equation number. -->

## Assumptions and limits

<!-- Valid range, known failure modes, identifiability concerns. -->

## Test data

<!-- A dataset with a known answer (published values or a synthetic case with known parameters). -->
